content.text: Two wakings at 19 months is really common. Try a short pause tonight when he wakes. Wait a couple of minutes before going in, so he gets a chance to settle himself back down. If you do go in, keep it boring: low voice, a quick pat, then leave while he's still a bit awake. Keep it the same every time, because the consistency is what makes it work. If something seems off, like fever or pain, check with your provider.
